references.text: The preceding verses describe the ingredients to be used in making the holy anointing oil
Instructions on how the holy anointing oil is to be used and a prohibition against making it for common use
The anointing oil is used to anoint Aaron as priest
Bezalel makes the holy anointing oil according to the instructions
The anointing oil is used to anoint the tabernacle and its utensils
Moses uses the anointing oil to anoint the tabernacle, the altar, and Aaron
Reference to the holy anointing oil in connection with the high priest
Poetic description of the precious oil that ran down over Aaron's head and beard
Prophetic text about the Lord's anointing, pointing toward the Messiah
Quotes Psalm 45:8 stating that God has anointed the Son with the oil of joy
Illustrates how both oil and incense require the same degree of divine precision to serve in the sanctuary.
Connects the production of the oil (source) to its application for consecrating God's dwelling (candidate).
Expands the definition of the oil's holiness from the source to specific prohibitions against misuse.
Shows a concrete use of the holy oil from the source at the dedication of the altar.
Links the production of the oil to its status as an eternal holy ordinance for all generations.
